crossRefs.note: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

translations.web: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
translations.bsb: the lambs will provide you with clothing, and the goats with the price of a field.
translations.kjv: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
translations.asv: The lambs are for thy clothing, And the goats are the price of the field;
